_about: Per-unit words for launch-film.mjs (the Higgsfield 3D launch film, 22.11.2026). color = the accent in plain words (the studio glow + the LEDs). screen = what the glass screen shows when it powers on in shot 4; leave it out and a safe generic line is used (the photo rules anyway). A NEW plugin needs no row: its colour is read from units.json, but a screen line makes a better film.

rone-dmt.screen: the teal waveform draws itself from left to right

rone-reverb.screen: the pink reverb cone and the five drawn knobs light up one after another

rone-stutter.screen: the gold stutter bars light up one after another

rone-iron.screen: the purple piano keys light up one after another

rone-clipper.screen: the blue waveform draws itself with the clipped peaks marked

rone-analyzer.screen: the cyan spectrum rises across the screen
